structured.answer: If my money stays in the עו"ש it shrinks: their example has 10,000 ₪ worth 8,203 in today's money after 10 years (1,797 less), so my 30,000 loses roughly three times that. I never saw my own figure because the field stayed on 10,000.

Big 62,681 ₪ at first reads like growth, but it's less than the 70,000 deposited
The alternative (קרן כספית) is mentioned but not explained in plain words, and there's no clear next step
